verdict.rationale: The documentation covers a fast payment-flow path. Overlay checkout via Paddle.js needs "minimal frontend coding." Paddle ships official server-side SDKs for Node.js, Python, Go and PHP, with webhook verification helpers. A Next.js starter kit yields a working subscription app, and a sandbox plus a Postman collection support testing. Missing for 10: direct evidence of copy-paste code snippets per language in the guides, and independent or hands-on corroboration that a developer reaches a working integration in under a day.
